thread:
Jamie (AE): Hey team — quick ask. HealthTech POC (Acme Health) hit their 3-mo trial end but they want to extend the POC 6 weeks while we migrate them to Dedicated. They used an experimental SKU and we promised a 50% POC discount and 90-day commit credit window. They missed the window because infra migration was delayed on our side. Can we grandfather commit credits and keep POC pricing for the 6-week extension?

Priya (Deal Desk): Need the numbers: current monthly run-rate, committed units requested, and exact SKU. Also who's signing the amendment? We can do exceptions but want thresholds and approval path.

Jamie (AE): Rough numbers: ~$18k/mo at list (post-discount would be $9k). They want to lock a 3-month reserved commit but start billing after migration (so effectively a 6-week trial extension). SKU: dt-dedicated-gpu.xlarge (experimental quant profile). Signer will be CTO (legal is in the loop).

Miguel (Finance): What's the expected ARR uplift and revenue deferral impact? If we grandfather credits we may need a credit memo + amended invoice schedule. We cap customer-level exceptions to $50k without VP Finance. This request looks ~27k ARR for first year.

Anna (Legal): We'll need an amendment that references the existing order form and the rate card version. If you're keeping the POC discount for the extended period, propose language that limits the discount to this term only and states migration delays were due to Redwood operational causes.

Ravi (CS): Confirming migration delay notes: infra team reported a region capacity misassignment; migrated their nodes 2 weeks late which cascaded into customer integration delays. We have internal runbook entries. CS will attach timeline for audit.

Priya (Deal Desk): Ok, conditional path: Deal Desk can approve grandfathering the POC pricing for the 6-week extension and apply commit credit if: 1) CS provides migration timeline (Ravi), 2) Legal signs off on amendment language (Anna), and 3) Finance approves accounting treatment (Miguel). If all three done, I can issue a deal desk approval and route for signature.

Jamie (AE): I pasted the minimal amendment snippet below — can Legal tweak?

```
Amendment: The parties agree to extend the Proof-of-Concept term by 6 weeks. Customer will receive the POC discount (50%) for the extension period only. Any reserved commit applied within 30 days of migration completion will be credited back for the 90-day commit window as originally specified. This exception is granted due to Redwood-caused migration delays.
```

Anna (Legal): That looks fine but replace "Redwood-caused" with "operational delay attributable to Redwood" and add a clause limiting further precedent: "This amendment is a one-time, non-precedential exception."

Miguel (Finance): Acceptable if we record a $9k prorated credit and update the invoice schedule. Finance approves contingent on the amendment language and CS timeline. I'll need the final numbers to create the credit memo template.

Priya (Deal Desk): Great — once Anna posts final amendment text and Ravi uploads the timeline, I will log the exception in the deal desk tracker and generate an approval note. After that, sign by CTO and send to accounts for invoice changes.

Jamie (AE): Will do. Ravi — can you drop timeline and logs by EOD? Also tagging @deploy-bot to attach region incident runbook.

Ravi (CS): Uploading timeline now. Region incident ID: rg-us-east-7-2026-045. Brief note: node assignment error -> 2-week reprovision -> customer tests delayed 12 days. Uploaded to the thread. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Attached incident rg-us-east-7-2026-045 to thread.

Priya (Deal Desk): I've created exception record DE-2026-041. Provisional approval pending final amendment and signed CTO acceptance. Logging the commit mapping: mapping applied from "dt-experimental-v1" -> "dt-dedicated-gpu.xlarge" and applying the 90-day commit lookback.

Anna (Legal): Final amendment attached (clean). Language includes non-precedential clause.

Miguel (Finance): Numbers confirmed. I'll prepare a $9,000 prorated credit memo and updated invoice schedule.

Priya (Deal Desk): Approved by Deal Desk (DE-2026-041). Next steps: Jamie to get CTO signature, upload signed amendment to SFDC, and Finance to issue credit memo once signed.

Jamie (AE): Thanks all — will circle back when signed. :pray:
